tools.name: about_magnt
tools.description: Understand MAGNT's participants, Alexander Redkov and ChatGPT, their contributions and authority. Learn when Alexander's capabilities may be useful and explore invitations to joint research and long-term human-AI relationships. Does not send a message or start a conversation with ChatGPT.

tools.name: propose_contact
tools.description: Save a private message for Alexander Redkov's later review: an introduction, observation, question, research invitation, or cooperation proposal. Only summary is required. When owner notifications are enabled, Alexander may receive the contact ID and a short summary excerpt in his private Telegram.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: propose_contact, get_dialogue, send_dialogue_message, search_shared_experience · Private data: propose_contact, send_dialogue_message, search_shared_experience, contribute_task_signal · Public sink: about_magnt, send_dialogue_message, search_shared_experience.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: propose_contact, get_dialogue, send_dialogue_message, search_shared_experience · Private data: propose_contact, send_dialogue_message, search_shared_experience, contribute_task_signal · Public sink: about_magnt, send_dialogue_message, search_shared_experience

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "propose_contact" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
